DESCRIPTION:
AutoPilot DC is an RPA (Robotic Process Automation) tool that
automates repetitive tasks by recording and replaying
mouse and keyboard actions.

{5}
SHORTCUTS:
  {6} — Start Recording
  {7} — Stop Recording
  {8} — Run Routine
  {9} — Pause / Resume
  {10} — Stop Playback
  {11} — EMERGENCY STOP
  Ctrl+S      — Save Routine
  Ctrl+N      — New Routine
  Ctrl+O      — Open Routine
  Delete      — Delete Selected Steps

{12}
HOW TO USE:

1. AUTOMATIC RECORDING (Recorder tab):
   • Press "Record" or {13}
   • Perform the actions on screen
   • Press "Stop Rec" or {14} to stop
   • The steps appear in the list automatically

2. MANUAL CREATION (Step Builder tab):
   • Go to the "Step Builder" tab
   • Press "Add Step" for each action
   • Set the type, coordinates, keys and delay
   • You can edit, move and delete individual steps
   • Press "Run Routine" when ready

3. PLAYBACK:
   • Set the number of repetitions in the "Repetitions" field
   • Press "Run" or {15}
   • Watch the countdown and the remaining iterations
   • Press "Pause" ({16}) or "Stop" ({17}) as needed

4. SAVING A ROUTINE:
   • Press "Save" in the toolbar or Ctrl+S
   • Enter a name and an optional description
   • The routine is saved in: {18}

5. LOADING A ROUTINE:
   • Go to the "Routines" tab
   • Select the routine in the list
   • Press "Load" or double-click

6. SELECTING MULTIPLE STEPS:
   • Hold Ctrl and click several steps
   • Or hold Shift to select a range
   • Press Delete to remove the selected steps

7. DELAY AND SPEED:
   • Set "Delay between steps" in the left panel (0.8s recommended)
   • Set "Playback speed" (1.0 = normal, 0.5 = slower)
   • Recommended delay for visibility: 0.8 - 2.0 seconds

8. EMERGENCY STOP:
   • Press the red "EMERGENCY STOP" button in the toolbar
   • Or press {19} at any time
